ev.text: No traders on the west road in days.
No traders on the west road in days.
Heard about Isolde? You did not hear it from me. Isolde is sweet on someone who is already spoken for.
Moss, you look worn out.
They say the pike in the lake are biting.
A long day. Nothing a seat and a bowl of stew will not mend.
Word has got round about our nights, I expect.
Word has got round about our nights, I expect.
Kael says that every week.
My grandmother swore the old ruins were a lord's hall once.
One of these weeks he will be right.
Isolde? Never. Are you sure?
Then we shall have to make do with our own company.
Then we shall have to make do with our own company.
Then go and sit. The work will keep.
Mine said worse things were buried there than lords.
Sure as sunrise.
There are worse things.
There are worse things.
Well. I shall be keeping an eye on Isolde, then.
Cheerful folk, our grandmothers.

entry.text: Vex told Aldric a made-up story about Isolde.
Brenna and Vex have tonight's watch.
